purpose: Teach: 大将/造っ/初戦/日立/造形/フラワー/チューブ/ムリ

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お寿司の大将、優しいよね、いつも、ぼくに、玉子、サービスしてくれる。
lines.en: Mom, the sushi chef is really kind—he always gives me free egg.
lines.style: Bright and earnest, slightly breathless. Not bragging, just sharing something he noticed and likes. Voice bounces up on 'free egg' like it's a small treasure.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うん。お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、自分で、家を造ったって、聞いてる?
lines.en: That's true. Did you know Grandpa actually built our house himself when he was young?
lines.style: Warm, approving tone. Gentle redirect—not dismissing his story, but sharing something she wants him to know. Speaking partly to him, partly to herself, remembering.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: サッカー、初戦、勝ったよ、ぼくのクラス!ママ、聞いて!
lines.en: Mom, my soccer team won our first game! Did you hear? We won!
lines.style: Tumbling over words with excitement. Louder than before, needing her to understand this matters. Quick, almost gasping delivery—he's been holding this in to tell her.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お父さんの会社、日立系列の電子部品、扱っているのよ、知ってた?
lines.en: Your father's company handles electronics components—they're part of the Hitachi group, you know.
lines.style: Quieter, more distant. Speaking aloud but half to herself. Noticing connections, offering context he may not fully follow yet. Slightly melancholic undertone.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 図工で、造形遊び、楽しかったよ、粘土で、立体作ったの。
lines.en: Art class was so fun today—we made 3D sculptures out of clay.
lines.style: Animated, tactile descriptions. His voice shows he's still feeling the clay in his hands. Genuine, unperformed joy. Modest speed, letting each word land.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お祖母ちゃん、フラワーアレンジメント、習い始めたって、お母さんが言ってたわよ。
lines.en: Your grandmother just started taking flower arrangement lessons—your aunt mentioned it to me.
lines.style: Soft, warm smile in the voice. Pleased observation, sharing the gentle news. Pace steady and unhurried. The tone of an adult noting how people are growing, quietly proud.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 歯磨き粉のチューブ、新しく、変えたよ、お母さん、見て、フルーツ味!
lines.en: I got a new toothpaste tube, Mom—look, it's fruit-flavored!
lines.style: Bright, bouncy presentation of a small discovery. Quick tempo. Inviting her to look with genuine enthusiasm about something minor, unaware of how small the excitement is to an adult.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ムリして、勉強し過ぎないようにね、翔くん、休憩も、大事よ。
lines.en: Don't push yourself too hard with studying, Sho. Rest is important too, sweetheart.
lines.style: Tender and gentle, with the weight of care underneath. Slower pace. Soft attack on his name. The voice of someone who has learned this lesson herself and doesn't want him to have to.
